items.question: How can I remove a Sora watermark from a video?
items.answer: Start with a clean source export or editable project whenever you have it. If a watermark is baked into a video you own, use a tool that explicitly handles moving marks across frames, then inspect the complete exported clip. WatermarkGemini’s dedicated Sora video workflow is currently Coming Soon.

items.question: Does the Sora watermark remover support Sora 2?
items.answer: Sora 2 is a target use case for this planned page, including visible marks that change position. The WatermarkGemini Sora-specific video processing and export formats have not been verified live, so the page must not claim active Sora 2 removal until tested.

items.question: Is there a free Sora watermark remover online?
items.answer: Some third-party services offer free previews or signup credits, but export limits vary. WatermarkGemini’s dedicated Sora processing is not confirmed available yet. Do not assume video tasks use the limited free-image allowance; review the actual video credit price after launch.

items.question: How do I remove a moving Sora 2 watermark?
items.answer: A moving mark requires checking its path across the whole clip, not masking a single frame. Inspect motion, cuts and the detail behind the logo, then test a short section using a verified tracker or source-level edit. The planned WatermarkGemini workflow must pass this test before launch claims are used.

items.question: Can a Sora video watermark be removed without cropping?
items.answer: A frame-aware editor may attempt to reconstruct only the marked area, avoiding a crop, but results depend on the scene and method. WatermarkGemini has not verified a Sora-specific no-crop export yet. A clean original is preferable when available.

items.question: Will removing a Sora watermark lower the video quality?
items.answer: Any encoded video cleanup can introduce compression, softness or flicker. Compare output resolution, frame rate, motion and sound with the original, especially in low light or detailed scenes. Claims of no quality loss require a measured product test, not a still comparison.

items.question: Can I upload a Sora video link instead of a file?
items.answer: The current WatermarkGemini page does not verify a Sora-link import feature. Keep your authorized source file and only use a link workflow if the published interface explicitly supports it. Do not infer URL support from other tools.

items.question: Can I remove a Sora watermark on iPhone or Android?
items.answer: Online video editors can sometimes run on mobile, but WatermarkGemini has not published verified Sora processing compatibility for either platform. For now, review the supported browser, clip limits and actual availability rather than assuming the shared upload control can complete the job.

items.question: Does removing a visible Sora logo remove AI provenance?
items.answer: No. A visible overlay and a separate AI provenance signal are different things. Cleaning an on-screen mark does not establish that hidden metadata, content credentials or AI-origin indicators have been removed. Keep legally required disclosures.

items.question: How long can a Sora video be for watermark removal?
items.answer: The shared uploader currently lists a general MP4 limit, but that does not certify the dedicated Sora remover’s maximum length or tracking behavior. Confirm the actual supported duration, file size and output limits when the feature launches.

items.question: Can I edit someone else’s Sora video?
items.answer: Only upload and modify media you own or have explicit authorization to edit. Watermark removal does not create copyright permissions or justify removing attribution. Obtain the clean original from the rights holder where necessary.

items.description: Cropping a watermark may cut a face, caption or carefully composed scene. A future frame-aware repair workflow should preserve the intended 16:9 or vertical frame when the background allows it. Today, choose a clean original export or a source-level edit before attempting a lossy crop.

items.heading: Inspect Motion, Texture and Audio After Cleanup
items.description: A clean still can hide blur, flicker and repeated patterns during playback. Before approving any Sora video watermark remover, test a short, difficult segment at the source frame rate and check audio, movement, compression and complex textures. WatermarkGemini will publish supported export details once the feature is verified.
